parameters.formDescription: Subscribe to receive notifications about upcoming DataTalk events via Email and Telegram.

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO subscribers (email, telegram, token, token_expiry, email_verified, telegram_verified, active, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.telegram }}', '{{ $json.token }}', '{{ $json.token_expiry }}', {{ $json.email_verified }}, {{ $json.telegram_verified }}, {{ $json.active }}, '{{ $json.created_at }}') RETURNING *

parameters.subject: Verify your DataTalk subscription
parameters.html:
=

Welcome to DataTalk Events!

Please verify your email by clicking the link below:

Verify Email

This link expires in 24 hours.

You also need to verify your Telegram to receive notifications.

parameters.responseBody:
=Thank you for subscribing!

Please check:
1. Your email ({{ $('Generate Token').first().json.email }}) for verification link
2. Your Telegram (@{{ $('Generate Token').first().json.telegram }}) for verification message

Both must be verified to receive notifications.
